name: Saginomiya Homare
source:
A first-year student in the Advanced Course. She's currently serving as the student council secretary.

Homare ended up leading her beloved stepsister Konoe to victory in the last year's student council election. She is extremely capable and always acts with her sister's best interests at heart.

At the time, however, Konoe refused her attempts to help, leading Homare to look for the reasons why.

[spoiler]She and Hikari became best friends over the course of the election.[/spoiler]

[Based on [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221024151940/http://www.virgo-resistance.sakura.ne.jp/watamari/]three[/url] [url=https://x.com/fenrirvier/status/1403934798297538562]separate[/url] [url=https://x.com/fenrirvier/status/2009865553901695245]descriptions[/url] provided by the author.]
